versions.changelog:
- Updated runtime/run.mjs for internal improvements.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

- Updated runtime documentation and code for improved clarity and operation.
- Adjusted CLI discovery logic in runtime/yaps-cli-discovery.mjs.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md documentation file.

- Initial release of the yaps skill.
- Supports general Yaps desktop app operations for speech, media, translation, and memory tasks not covered by a focused Yaps skill.
- Guides new users to install Yaps, sign in, and confirm access before use.
- Emphasizes use of documented command groups and discourages inventing features or commands.
- Directs UI-only feature requests (e.g., PDF/handwriting import) to the Yaps app.
- Ensures credentials and payment details are not collected via the skill.
